result.summary: The page is largely well-designed and consistent. One minor content/styling oddity stands out: a discount badge showing "-0%" on the pizza card, which is a meaningless promotion value. Horizontally clipped carousel items and the bottom-cut card are expected behaviors and not reported.

issues.description: The pizza card displays a discount badge reading "-0%", which is a nonsensical promotion (zero percent off) and looks like a data or logic error.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount value is 0, or ensure the backend only supplies a badge when a real promotion exists.
